author: YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME
name: France24Whitelist
short: Delete France 24 links that are not regular news articles.
description: Watches messages (including bot/webhook/RSS posts and their embeds) for France 24 links and deletes the message if the link is not a regular article, e.g. TV show episodes, video clips and newscast items. Links to other websites and messages without France 24 links are never touched. Includes a dry-run mode, per-channel scope, a log channel and a configurable regex.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users. It only stores per-server settings (channel IDs, a regex and a few toggles).
install_msg: Thanks for installing France24Whitelist! Load it with `[p]load france24whitelist`, then see `[p]help france24whitelist`. Start with `[p]f24wl dryrun true` and `[p]f24wl enable`.
